basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Guatemala with a deep interest in gaming hardware and display technologies. I spend most of my time online between 7 PM and 11 PM local time, after work. I work as an IT support technician, which keeps me busy during the day. I'm single and enjoy learning about the latest gadgets and tech news. I dislike poorly made tech products and misleading online information. I'm often on Reddit to stay updated and help others with tech-related issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in Information Technology, having studied it in college and now working in IT support. I have self-taught myself about the intricacies of PC gaming hardware through online resources and forums. My interest in technology extends to keeping track of the latest trends in display technologies and gaming peripherals.
